waybettercoppergolem.settings.learn.tool: Reads every chest inside this zone's area and proposes a label for each from what it already holds. You get a preview in chat and apply it with one click.
waybettercoppergolem.learn.header: Learn: %s chests get a label, %s skipped (radius %s)
waybettercoppergolem.learn.truncated: Too many chests; only the nearest 2000 were considered. Use a smaller radius.
waybettercoppergolem.learn.stale: %s chests changed since the preview and were left alone.
waybettercoppergolem.learn.nothing_pendi: No pending proposal. Run /wbcg learn first (proposals expire after 2 minutes).
waybettercoppergolem.learn.not_allowed: The learn pass needs operator permission on this server.
waybettercoppergolem.settings.set_area.t: Closes this screen. Then sneak-right-click two opposite corners with the label tool; the box between them becomes the zone. Sneak-right-click the air to cancel.
waybettercoppergolem.settings.reset_area: Back to the default box around the anchor chest (65 wide, 17 tall).
waybettercoppergolem.zone.none: You are not inside any sorting zone. Sneak-right-click a copper chest with an empty hand to create one.
waybettercoppergolem.area.begin: Area mode: sneak-right-click the first corner holding the %s (sneak-right-click the air to cancel).
waybettercoppergolem.area.first: Corner 1 set. Now sneak-right-click the opposite corner.
waybettercoppergolem.area.done_expanded: Zone area set: %s blocks (expanded to include the anchor chest).
waybettercoppergolem.area.expired: Area mode timed out. Press "Set area" again.
waybettercoppergolem.picker.title: Pick a label for the clipboard
waybettercoppergolem.picker.catch_all.to: Items matching no other label anywhere go to this chest.
waybettercoppergolem.picker.off_limits.t: Golems never deposit into, claim, or reorganize this chest.
waybettercoppergolem.picker.remove_label: Pasting this removes a chest's labels: it goes back to its frames, or to vanilla behavior.
waybettercoppergolem.hud.no_zone: No zone — sneak-right-click with an empty hand to create one
